title: Good design bad ux
body:
The app is generally good. One thing that irritates me is the slow responsiveness. One example is the way we go to get from a task to another. The scroll isn’t free, it stops on each habit making it impossible to scroll fast through multiple habits at once.
Lately I noticed the app got really laggy, it wasn’t like that before.
I wish there was a bad habit tracking. Something that goes more with the direction of “don’t do” the habit.
One last thing is that i wish the full list of habits was a fixed screen like the habits, it’d be more effective to have it as default screen if we don’t want to be scrolling to reach a habit. With time it gets boring.
